product_overview: SubePe Admin is a web admin panel for managing the SubePe fare collection system. It provides administrators with access to login, a dashboard with operational metrics, and management views for drivers, buses, passengers, trips, pricing, announcements, and penalties.
core_goals: Sign in to access the administrative panel
View dashboard metrics and operational trends

features.name: Administrator Login
features.description: Allow an administrator to access the protected admin area by entering credentials on the login page.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> See the dashboard

features.name: Dashboard Overview
features.description: Let administrators review key system metrics and trend charts from the main dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> See summary cards for passengers, drivers, monthly trips, and revenue -> Review trip and recharge trend charts

features.name: Driver Management
features.description: Let administrators view the driver list and add new drivers through a form.
user_flows: Navigate to /conductores -> View the driver table -> Start adding a driver -> Fill in driver details -> Submit the driver form -> See the new driver in the list

features.name: Bus Unit Management
features.description: Let administrators register and manage bus units from the units page.
user_flows: Navigate to /unidades -> Start adding a bus unit -> Fill in the bus plate -> Fill in the bus name -> Submit the bus form -> See the new bus unit listed

features.name: Passenger Directory
features.description: Let administrators view the passenger list for system oversight.
user_flows: Navigate to /pasajeros -> View the passenger list

features.name: Trip Records
features.description: Let administrators review trip history and trip-related activity.
user_flows: Navigate to /viajes -> View the trip list

features.name: Fare Pricing Management
features.description: Let administrators inspect and update fare prices for different passenger categories.
user_flows: Navigate to /tarifario -> View fare categories -> Start editing a fare price -> Update the fare amount -> Save the change -> See the updated fare in the pricing list

features.name: Announcements Management
features.description: Let administrators manage system announcements from the announcements page.

features.name: Penalty Review
features.description: Let administrators review recorded penalties from the penalties page.
